title: AI Engineer & AI Expert
audience: Learners who want to build, evaluate, govern, and ship reliable AI systems
promise: Progress from the Python foundations AI work depends on to production-quality AI applications you can explain and defend.

modules.title: Python foundations for AI
modules.mental_model: AI applications are still software: Python values, decisions, functions, data boundaries, and failure handling make model behavior usable and safe.
evidence: calls an HTTP API without hard-coded secrets
common_mistakes: rushes to an AI library before understanding Python data
understanding_checks: What information enters this function?
What can fail outside the program?
Why must the key stay outside the source file?
projects: a rule-based support-ticket classifier in plain Python
a JSON-backed prompt experiment tracker
a resilient Python API client using synthetic data

modules.title: Data and model thinking
modules.mental_model: A useful AI system begins with a clearly framed decision and trustworthy evidence, not with a fashionable model.
evidence: separates learning data from evaluation data
common_mistakes: uses accuracy without examining error costs
understanding_checks: What decision will this output support?
What would a no-model baseline do?
Which error is more costly?
projects: profile a synthetic support-ticket dataset
frame and baseline a synthetic priority predictor
compare model errors against a business-aware metric

modules.title: Build dependable LLM applications
modules.mental_model: An LLM is a probabilistic component behind an interface; dependable applications constrain inputs, validate outputs, and handle failure explicitly.
evidence: calls an LLM through a provider boundary
common_mistakes: treats prompts as the whole product
couples application logic to one provider
understanding_checks: What contract surrounds the model?
What happens when output is invalid?
Which logic should remain deterministic?
projects: a provider-neutral text classification client
a structured-output meeting-action extractor
an LLM application with timeout retry and fallback

modules.title: Ground AI with retrieval
modules.mental_model: Retrieval does not give a model knowledge; it selects evidence that the model must use, cite, and remain bounded by.
common_mistakes: allows answers unsupported by retrieved text
understanding_checks: Was the needed evidence retrieved?
Does the answer follow from that evidence?
When should the system abstain?
projects: a local RAG assistant over sanitized documents
a retrieval-quality evaluation set
a grounded assistant that cites evidence and abstains

modules.title: Agents, tools, and workflow design
modules.mental_model: An agent is a controlled decision loop around models and tools; every capability needs a boundary, observable state, and stopping rule.
common_mistakes: uses an agent where a workflow is enough
has no stop or recovery condition
understanding_checks: Why is an agent needed here?
What is the maximum authority of this tool?
How does the loop stop safely?
projects: a deterministic workflow with one LLM decision
a tool-calling research assistant over synthetic data
an approval-gated multi-step agent

modules.title: Evals, safety, and governance
modules.mental_model: AI quality is an evidence and risk-management discipline: define desired behavior, unacceptable failure, accountable ownership, and release gates.
evidence: defines human escalation and release criteria
common_mistakes: treats policy language as a technical control
understanding_checks: Which failure would block release?
Who owns this risk?
Which control is preventative, detective, or corrective?
projects: an eval harness for a support assistant
a prompt-injection and unsafe-tool test suite
an AI system card with risk controls and release gates

modules.title: Ship and operate AI systems
modules.mental_model: Shipping is the beginning of the evidence cycle: production AI needs versioning, monitoring, cost and latency controls, rollback, and accountable change management.
common_mistakes: monitors uptime but not answer quality
understanding_checks: How will you detect quality drift?
Which version produced this response?
What triggers rollback?
projects: a deployable AI API with configuration and health checks
an observability dashboard over synthetic traces
a production-readiness review and rollback plan
